limits.deadline_semantics: Absolute stable-input deadline passed into request execution; guard and polling clamped to deadline. Request window bounds completion, guard included when time remains.

limitations: Finite software register model; no hardware or illuminance accuracy validation.
Table11 nominal integration time is a model stimulus, not a hard API deadline.
Previously completed readings remain valid; no mandatory new epoch or global idle.
Nominal eight-bit data is zero extended. Nonzero unused high bits are separately reported model-stress diagnostics, not asserted physical occurrences.
Brownout acknowledgment and identity probing are diagnostic; no unselected interrupt persistence policy.
No whole two-byte atomicity obligation for an eight-bit selected result.
Fault and wrong-device diagnostics do not imply exhaustive recovery coverage.
Not an OS sandbox for hostile code.
